params.body:
## Why

`composer audit --locked` (the job "Dependencies carry no new advisory") now finds six advisories in `web-auth/webauthn-lib` 5.3.9, the passkey library. They were published after main's last green run on 2026-11-18, and every pull request goes red on them, for example #1112. They concern CBOR length checks, attestation certificates sent as PEM text, metadata status reports and fake-credential decoys, and all are fixed from 5.3.13.

## What changes

- `composer update web-auth/webauthn-lib` takes it to 5.3.17.
- Only that package's entry in `composer.lock` changes.
- It brings no new or changed dependencies.

## Tests

- `composer audit --locked`: no advisories.
- `TwoFactorTest`, `PasskeyRoutesTest` and `ACodeByMailIsASecondFactorTest`: green (34).
- The full suite: green.

After the merge, the red job on #1112 can run again: it audits the merge ref.
params.title: Bump web-auth/webauthn-lib to 5.3.17 for six advisories
